chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who prayed while he was traveling, and he completed the prayer. He said: If it is still within the time, then let him repeat it; but if the time has already passed, then no.

key_terms.أَتَمَّ: he performed fully, completing the prayer instead of shortening it
key_terms.الْوَقْتُ: the legally designated time of the prayer
key_terms.مُسَافِرٌ: a traveler subject to the rulings of travel prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a traveler mistakenly performs the prayer in full instead of shortening it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a traveler who performed the prayer in complete form instead of the shortened form. If the prayer time remains, he must repeat it; if the time has passed, he does not repeat it.
